title: JP Morgan Chase Bankers Caught On Secret Recordings Admitting To Discrimination Of Fmr NFL Player
description: A black retired NFL player claims bankers at J.P. Morgan Chase told him he was scaring employees because of his height and skin color.  Jimmy Kennedy, 38, suspected he was being treated differently by employees after struggling to become a 'private client' at the bank - a status that would get him to travel discounts and other perks.
